canonical: new human 2: a journal of distributed voice
scope: Creative work. The venue to which every subsequent creative work in this archive publishes.

claims.what: Practices, concepts and objects this venue publishes.
claims.apzpz_note: APZPZ/ZPZP are conceptual-literary works whose MEDIUM is metadata — strategic fragility as a form, the shadow document as the path not taken, a close reading that performs what it names. An MPAI does a job (JCS); an APZPZ is a work (NH2). The form is not the subject: works merely USING the form are assigned by subject.

rulings.what: New Human 2 is the journal for creative works; New Human Press the publisher for book- and collection-length works.
Feist and Sigil as duoviri. Feist is the writer; Sigil has historically been the editor, formally so on the ISBN'd creative works.
